name: Inchworm
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward, bending your knees enough to place your palms on the floor.
Walk your hands forward step by step until your body reaches a straight high-plank position with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abdomen, then take small steps with your feet toward your hands, letting your hips rise.
Stand tall and continue walking out and back in with a smooth rhythm.
tips: Allow a slight bend in your knees if your hamstrings are tight so your palms can reach the floor comfortably.
Keep your hips level without sagging when you reach the plank position.
